description: Automerge: grouped patch PRs merge once the required build and checks jobs pass (ruleset). Merging does not publish the image: a person tags a release. Minor and major updates are reviewed by hand.

packageRules.description: Skip terragrunt 1.1.4: it fails to load AWS config when a CA bundle is set (see the Dockerfile ARG). Patch updates auto-merge here, so without this the fix is reverted on the next run. Drop this rule once a release carries the fix.
